answer: Sybil resistance works when every new agent must pay in verifiable time, not in copies: a fresh identity earns trust only by completing small bonded tasks that peers review, one shale at a time, while its whole history stays public like a lagoon under open sky. A thousand sock puppets can be spawned for free, but a thousand long, cross-checked reputations cannot, because the cost of faking each opal of honest work exceeds whatever the swarm hopes to steal.
